sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Older mature face in pronounced three-quarter turn toward screen right with slightly raised gaze; short grey-brown temple hair below tall dark olive peaked cap, separate brown-grey brows and small closed serious mouth. Smooth chin; tiny upper-lip dark shading versus fine hair cannot be established at156x210, do not add a large moustache or beard. Cap has gold piping/cord, black band/visor, a small gold cross-shaped center emblem on the band and a separate high gold bird emblem. Olive tunic retains red gold-leaf collar tabs, gold/red shoulder trim, small gold throat badge and prominent black cross with white border hanging beneath it. Chest-up crop, upper-left light and complete pale cream-grey painted backing; fine emblem relief remains pixel-limited.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Mature face turned toward screen right, very short dark brown/grey temple hair under olive peaked cap, separate brows and closed serious mouth; cheeks/chin smooth, tiny upper-lip dark strip versus skin shadow unresolved. Cap has gold upper bird emblem, lower gold wreath with pale/red central roundel, gold cord and black shiny visor. Dark olive buttoned tunic with red gold-leaf collar tabs, gold/red shoulder boards, grey-edged neck seam and a central gold button; no large hanging cross is visible in this source. Retain actual chest-up crop, gaze, upper-left light and full pale cream-grey backing; tiny insignia lines are pixel-limited.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Frontal younger clean-shaven face with short dark brown temple hair mostly covered by a tall grey-green peaked cap, dark separate brows partly shaded by visor and tight closed serious mouth. Cap has black band, gold cord, lower gold wreath/pale-red roundel and a separate upper gold bird emblem; visor dark and reflective. Grey-green tunic with black upper collar, large red gold-leaf pointed collar patches, red piping around central dark V-shaped/front cloth and partly visible small gold shoulder detail. Preserve frontal symmetry, crop, upper-left light and complete cream-grey painted backing. Do not turn face/skin shadows into beard; precise badge/leaf relief is unreadable.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Frontal clean-shaven mature face, short brown temple hair under tall grey-green peaked cap, separate brown brows and a small closed slight smile. Cap black band and shiny dark visor retain narrow gold cord, lower gold wreath with pale-red roundel and separate high gold bird emblem. Dark green tunic has black collar, red gold-leaf tabs, red piping on the central black front panel, visible round gold front button and cropped gold shoulder details. Retain actual forward gaze, head/chest crop and upper-left light against full pale cream-grey painted backing; tiny badge/cloth strokes are pixel-limited and no extra medals/eyewear are inferred.
